## Summary

I updated the WebAssembly interface library to use `wasmparser` 0.121.0 (the workspace-defined version).

**`lib/wasm-interface/Cargo.toml`** — changed the pinned `wasmparser = { version = "0.51.4", optional = true }` to `wasmparser = { workspace = true, optional = true }`.

**`lib/wasm-interface/src/validate.rs`** — migrated from the deprecated `ValidatingParser`/`WasmDecoder` state-machine API to the modern API:

- Validation now uses `Validator::new_with_features(WasmFeatures { threads: true, reference_types: true, simd: true, bulk_memory: true, multi_value: true, ..Default::default() })` and calls `validator.validate_all(wasm)` to validate the module.
- Section data (imports, exports, globals, types, function signatures) is gathered by iterating `Parser::new(0).parse_all(wasm)` over `Payload` variants instead of `ParserState`. Types are extracted from the new `TypeSection` → `RecGroup` → `SubType`/`CompositeType::Func` structure; imports/exports read from `TypeRef` and `ExternalKind` respectively.
- Helper functions updated for `FuncType`'s method-based accessors (`.params()`/`.results()` instead of `.params`/`.returns` fields), removed the obsolete `type_sig.form == wasmparser::Type::Func` asserts, and `wasmparser_type_into_wasm_type` now maps from `ValType` instead of the removed `Type` enum.

Global import/export type-mismatch checking logic is preserved. The package builds cleanly and all 16 pre-existing tests pass (including `global_imports` and `global_exports`). No `tests/` directory files were touched.
